meta.title: 16-18 (key stage 5) attainment and retention by local authority
meta.geography: LA, region, England, Bedfordshire (3 UAs, student counts only)
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics covering state-funded schools and colleges; LA is the location of the institution, not student residence.
meta.limitations: Average point scores cannot be summed or averaged to a Bedfordshire figure (no entry counts published), so Bedfordshire rows exist only for student counts. T level results are not published at LA level in this data set (national only) - a gap. Bedford's figures are dominated by Bedford College, which draws students from a wide area. 2020/21 TAGs and 2021/22 transitional grading are not comparable with later years. Retention data cover students in two-year programmes; England figures come from the national cohort time series. Small-cohort suppression (c/x/z) -> null.

indicators.label: Average point score per entry
indicators.description: APS per entry by qualification cohort (breakdown: A level, Applied general, Tech level, Technical certificate).

indicators.label: % achieving 2+ substantial level 3 qualifications
indicators.description: Share of level 3 students (or A level students) achieving at least two substantial level 3 qualifications.

indicators.label: Students at end of 16-18 study
indicators.description: Number of students in each exam cohort at the end of 16-18 study (by institution location).

indicators.label: % retained and assessed
indicators.description: Percentage of students on two-year programmes retained to the end and assessed, by cohort and level.
